input: A team is migrating from IP-XACT 2009 (IEEE 1685-2009) to IP-XACT 2022. The extractor uses the 2009 XML namespace and fails to parse 2022 files that use the updated spirit:2022 namespace. What are the key structural differences between IP-XACT 2009 and 2022 that affect parsing, and how should the extractor auto-detect and handle both versions?
